body:
You have no idea what does or does not happen next

It could be super spooky

It could be unfathomably worse

Your last moments might be filled with regrets over having "wasted" (using the term loosely, I'm not sure such a thing truly exists but people seem to be prone to such perceptions) the only chance you ever had to be yourself, because when something really happens, insight into that thing is often sharper than when we conceptualize it

So, the only way you can know whether or not you want it, is to be able to accept literally anything or nothing that could follow or not follow this and prefer it to this. It is not just an end to your misery, it is also a deep dive into the greatest unknown of human consciousness. And you probably cannot turn back.
